_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining currency exchange rates for various transactions within the enterprise system.

columns.name: CurrencyRateID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Sales CurrencyRate

columns.name: CurrencyRateDate
columns.description: Stores date of currency exchange rates recorded.

columns.name: FromCurrencyCode
columns.description: Stores ISO 10-letter currency codes for the base currencies of exchange rates in Sales CurrencyRate.

columns.name: ToCurrencyCode
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166 currency codes for currencies to which sales rates are converted.

columns.name: AverageRate
columns.description: Stores average exchange rates for the sales currency.

columns.name: EndOfDayRate
columns.description: EndOfDayRate stores daily exchange rates for the sales currency.

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores timestamp of the last modification for each record in Sales CurrencyRate table (2014-01-02 17:39:45.260).
